tips.text: Place Yordle Snap Trap ahead of time on brush edges and where the enemy walks, so one is ready when a fight starts.
Attack an enemy who is rooted by a trap; Caitlyn's Headshot then reaches far and hits harder.
Fire Piltover Peacemaker down a line of minions into the enemy; it hits for less after the first target, but a trapped enemy always takes full damage.
Fire the net away from the enemy to escape a gap closer. It also slows whoever it hits.
Hop over thin walls with the net, since the backward push can carry you through terrain.
Skip Ace in the Hole in a big team fight; another enemy champion can step into its path and block it. Use it on a lone, weakened target.
Stay out of danger while channeling Ace in the Hole, because Caitlyn can't move or act and being interrupted cancels it.
Chain the net onto an enemy for a free long-range Headshot, then follow up with Piltover Peacemaker.

combos.name: Net hop over wall
combos.when: When you need to escape or cross a thin wall.
combos.text: Fire the net in the direction away from where you want to go. The recoil carries Caitlyn backwards and can pass through thin terrain.

tips.text: Poke Aphelios with Piltover Peacemaker from long range when he steps up to last-hit; Caitlyn outranges him in the early levels.
Drop a Yordle Snap Trap in front of you before he walks up, so one is ready when he trades.
Fire your net away from him when he closes in. It slows him and pushes you backwards.
Do not channel Ace in the Hole with enemies around. Another champion can step in front and take the shot, and you cannot move while channeling.
Step back from him when he holds the purple Gravity gun. Once he slows you, he can root you.
Place Yordle Snap Trap ahead of time on the path Ashe walks. Keep a trap ready for when she steps up to fight.
Ashe has few escapes, so open with Piltover Peacemaker on a rooted Ashe and follow with a Headshot.
Use your net to slow Ashe and back away when she closes in; the recoil pushes you away.
Stay out of long straight lines when Ashe has Enchanted Crystal Arrow ready; one hit means a long stun and a dead lane.
Stay out of Brand's range and poke him with Piltover Peacemaker; its long range lets you hit him before he can reach you.
Walk out of the way of Sear and Pillar of Flame. Brand has to land one of them before his combo can start.
Once Brand has set you ablaze, do not stand still. Sear will stun you, so keep moving until the burn wears off.
Place Yordle Snap Trap on the ground where Brand stands to cast. If he steps on it, he is rooted, and you get a free Headshot and Piltover Peacemaker on him.
If Brand gets close, fire your net at him to slow him and jump backward out of his range.
Stay away from your support when Brand is near. Conflagration spreads to nearby enemies, and an ablaze target makes it spread twice as far.
Poke Cassiopeia with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; she has to walk up to hit you with Noxious Blast.
Place Yordle Snap Trap where Cassiopeia stands to farm or fight, and keep one ready for when she walks up.
Fire your net at her to slow her and recoil away when she closes in. Your own range then lets you keep hitting her.
Do not fight inside Miasma. It slows you and stops your dashes, so your net's recoil will not work there.
Do not face Cassiopeia when she casts Petrifying Gaze at level 6. Walk away so you are slowed instead of stunned.
Poke Corki with Piltover Peacemaker from max range; he has to get close to trade well.
Place Yordle Snap Trap on the path where Corki walks up to you, and ahead of fights so one is ready.
Fire your net at Corki when he commits with Gatling Gun; it slows him and pushes you back out of range.
Don't stand behind minions against Missile Barrage; the splash hits you anyway. Stay out of its long range.
Punish Corki right after he uses Valkyrie to enter a fight; he is vulnerable then.
Poke Draven with Piltover Peacemaker when he steps up to catch a Spinning Axe. Her long range lets you hit him from well outside his reach.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in the spot where his Spinning Axe will land. He often walks there to catch it.
Once Draven is rooted by a trap, hit him with a Headshot from long range, then follow with Piltover Peacemaker.
Fire your net away from Draven when he runs at you. It slows him and moves you back out of his reach.
Draven's Stand Aside knocks you aside and slows you. Stay out of its line, and do not stand still in a straight line from him.
Use Ace in the Hole on a wounded Draven only when no minion or other champion is in its path.
Out-range Ezreal with Piltover Peacemaker from far away, and stay out of his Mystic Shot range while you do.
Fire Piltover Peacemaker through a minion at Ezreal; it passes through the first target and hits him too.
Place Yordle Snap Trap where Ezreal stands to farm, so he is rooted when he steps in and you can follow up.
If Ezreal blinks away with Arcane Shift, hit him with 90 Caliber Net to slow him, then land your Headshot from long range.
Ace in the Hole can finish a low-health Ezreal from across the map, since he is fragile. Only his allies can step in front of the shot.
Stay out of Hwei's reach and poke him with Piltover Peacemaker; its long range lets you hit him before he can answer.
Place Yordle Snap Trap where Hwei will stand to cast. A trapped Hwei is rooted, so follow up with a Headshot.
Hwei's Severing Bolt lands after a delay, so keep walking sideways and it will miss. Stand still and it hurts.
Use your net to slow Hwei when he rushes you, and its recoil moves you away from him.
Hwei is open to attack right after he casts a Torment spell, so jump on him with Piltover Peacemaker then.

comboRefs.note: The E net hop gives Caitlyn a way to back out of Hwei's Grim Visage fear and slow pressure.

tips.text: Poke Jhin with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; its range outreaches his basic attacks, so trade when he steps up to last-hit.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in the brush and on the paths Jhin walks. Anyone who steps on one is rooted, so you get a free Headshot.
Walk around Jhin's Captive Audience traps. They are invisible, so stay out of the spots he is likely to place them, like near your own position.
Step in when Jhin has used his four shots and is reloading; he cannot attack then. Use Headshot to hit him from afar.
Stay out of a straight line with Jhin when your support or minions are hurting you. Deadly Flourish roots anyone he has just damaged.
Poke Jinx with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; its range is longer than Jinx's basic attack, even with her rockets.
Place Yordle Snap Trap near your lane position and in brush before Jinx walks up. A trapped Jinx is rooted and takes extra Headshot damage.
Jinx's Flame Chompers is her main defense. Wait until she wastes it, then go in on her.
Use 90 Caliber Net on Jinx when she gets close. It slows her and pushes you away, so you can then shoot her from safety.
Do not walk over Jinx's chompers when you back away. They go off on contact and root you.
Take Ace in the Hole when Jinx is low, but watch for allies stepping in front of the shot, because other enemy champions can intercept it.
Poke Kai'Sa with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; her Icathian Rain only works with a nearby enemy, so she can't answer you from afar.
Place Yordle Snap Trap behind your minions and near your own side of lane. Kai'Sa has to come to you to trade, and a trapped target is easy to hit.
When Kai'Sa dashes in with Killer Instinct, slow her with your net and recoil away, then shoot her.
Hit Kai'Sa with Piltover Peacemaker when she stands behind a minion wave. The shot passes through the first target and widens.
Stay away from allies being locked down near Kai'Sa. Their stuns and roots add Plasma, which lets her Killer Instinct jump onto you.
Poke Kalista with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; her attacks must come close, so you can hit her before she can hit back.
Put Yordle Snap Trap where Kalista hops in to fight. She dashes a lot, so a trap behind her own attack lunge can leave her rooted.
Fire your net at Kalista when she lunges at you. It slows her and pushes you back out of reach.
Her basic attack windup can't be cancelled, so step out of range or cast a skillshot as soon as she starts attacking.
Stand behind your minions so Kalista's Pierce stops at the first one. Keep your distance so she can't stack spears on you for Rend.
Stay behind your minions when Karthus uses Lay Waste, so it hits more than one target and does less damage.
Outrange Karthus with Piltover Peacemaker and shoot him whenever he steps forward to farm.
Place Yordle Snap Trap behind you where Karthus walks to hit you, so you can punish him if he moves in.
Do not stand on a dead Karthus; he keeps casting Defile for a few seconds after dying.
Keep your health up once Karthus reaches level 6, because Requiem hits you from anywhere. Back off to heal when you're low.
Use your net to hop away from Wall of Pain, or to slow Karthus when he walks up to trade.
Early on, poke Kog'Maw with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; he has little reach before he gets Bio-Arcane Barrage up.
Play aggressively when Bio-Arcane Barrage is on cooldown, because Kog'Maw has much less range then.
Put Yordle Snap Trap where Kog'Maw stands to farm, so a step forward leaves him rooted and open to a Headshot.
Kog'Maw has no escape, so when he is rooted or slowed, pile on damage and go for the kill.
Step out of Void Ooze trails; use 90 Caliber Net to back away if you are caught in one.
Once Kog'Maw dies, run away from him; he explodes after a few seconds and hurts anyone close.
Poke Lucian with Piltover Peacemaker from long range while he waits for minions; he has to close the gap to trade back.
Place Yordle Snap Trap behind you or on the lane edge before Lucian walks up. If he steps on it he is rooted, and your Headshot hits harder.
Fire your net away from Lucian when he dashes in; it slows him and throws you backwards out of his burst.
Lucian has strong burst but little sustained damage, so back off after his combo and punish him while his dash is on cooldown.
Line up Piltover Peacemaker so Lucian is the first enemy it hits; later targets take less damage, so a minion in front weakens it.

comboRefs.note: The net recoil lets Caitlyn escape backwards from Lucian's close-range burst and dash pressure.

tips.text: Lean on Piltover Peacemaker's long range to poke Lux from outside her reach, especially when she walks up to a minion.
Stay out of a straight line with Lux and keep minions between you, because Light Binding only roots the first two enemies it hits.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in front of you before Lux can walk up. It punishes her for stepping forward to poke.
If Lux roots you with Light Binding, do not expect your net to push you away. It will not push you while you are rooted.
Do not stand still in Lucent Singularity. Step out before it blows up so you do not get slowed and hit.
Lux has little health, so punish her when she misses Light Binding. Net her, then attack for the extra range Headshot.
Watch out when Lux reaches level 6. Final Spark has huge range, so move sideways when you see its red warning line.
Poke Miss Fortune with Piltover Peacemaker and your long basic attacks while she stays back. You outrange her, so make her lose health for last-hitting.
Put Yordle Snap Trap on the spots where Miss Fortune steps to hit minions or to dodge. If it roots her, you get a long-range Headshot.
Stay out of Make It Rain, because its slow makes you easy to catch. Fire your net backwards to get away if she closes in.
Stand away from the minion that Double Up targets, so the bounce cannot hit you. A minion in front is no cover.
Never stand still in a line of enemies when Miss Fortune is about to cast Bullet Time. Move out of the cone or dash away with your net.
Place Yordle Snap Trap on the ground ahead of time where Nilah wants to step in, and keep one trap ready for when she dashes in.
Use the net when Nilah dashes at you; it leaves her slowed and pushes you back out of her reach.
Poke Nilah from long range with Piltover Peacemaker, and line it up through minions so it reaches her.
Do not waste Ace in the Hole while Jubilant Veil is up; her mist reduces damage and she can run away.
Stay at long range. Nilah's attacks gain range after Formless Blade, so back away once she has hit you with it.
Keep Samira at long range with Piltover Peacemaker; she has to dash in to fight, so poke her whenever she steps up to last-hit.
Do not rely on Piltover Peacemaker landing when Samira is spinning Blade Whirl; it destroys enemy missiles in its area.
Samira dashes onto anyone who is rooted or stunned. Don't stand still near her; place Yordle Snap Trap behind you and lure her over it.
Use your net when Samira dashes in with Wild Rush. It slows her and knocks you back out of her reach.
Do not fire Ace in the Hole near other enemies; they can step in the way and take the shot. Save it for a clear line.
Poke Senna with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; her basic attack range is short until she gathers Mist, so you out-range her early.
Shoot Piltover Peacemaker through minions toward Senna only when it reaches her first, because later targets take less damage.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in front of you before Senna walks up. If she is rooted, you can hit her with a long-range Headshot.
Keep your net ready for when Senna or her support closes in. It slows them and knocks you backward, out of range.
Stay out of Last Embrace's line. Her root can hold you in place, so keep minions between you and her.
Kill the Mist Wraiths before Senna can free them. Do not let her gather Mist for free.
Poke Sivir with Piltover Peacemaker, but wait for her Spell Shield to be used, since it blocks the shot.
Do not throw Yordle Snap Trap or your net at Sivir while her Spell Shield is up; it blocks them and she heals.
Stay at long range and fight Sivir's Boomerang Blade by sidestepping it; it comes back, so avoid its return path too.
Sivir pushes hard with Ricochet, so keep clearing waves or she will push you under your tower.
Poke Smolder early with Piltover Peacemaker; he is weak before he stacks Dragon Practice, and your range is longer than his.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in front of your lane before he walks up to farm. A rooted Smolder is easy to hit with a Headshot.
Stay out of his flight range. When Smolder uses Flap, Flap, Flap, hit him with your net to slow him and get away.
Stay out of a straight line with him, since his long range slow comes from Achooo!
Keep Ace in the Hole for when he is low after a trade. Check that no other enemy stands in the line, or they will take the shot.
Poke Tristana with Piltover Peacemaker early while you have more range, and keep her away from your minions' line.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in front of you before she jumps in; it roots her and sets up a Headshot.
Fire your net at Tristana when she dives; it slows her and pushes you back out of reach.
Do not stand next to your minions when Tristana has Explosive Charge on you; the blast hurts nearby enemies too. Back away before it goes off.
When Tristana has Buster Shot ready, do not stand where she can reach you; the knockback and stun leave you open.
Place Yordle Snap Trap in front of you and in brush before trading; Twitch must walk through them to reach you.
Poke Twitch with Piltover Peacemaker from max range; he has to close the gap to hit back.
Fire the net away from Twitch if he gets close; it slows him and pushes you back.
Twitch is fragile and can sneak up with Ambush, so ward and keep a trap ready when he vanishes.
Respect Twitch after level 6; Spray and Pray extends his reach and bolts pass through minions.
Use your long range to poke Varus with Headshot when he steps up to last-hit; you outrange him in a normal trade.
Fire Piltover Peacemaker through minions toward Varus; it pierces and reaches far.
Place Yordle Snap Trap on the spots Varus walks to when dodging, and in bushes where he wants to stand.
Keep your net ready for when Varus runs in after Hail of Arrows; it slows him and throws you backward to safety.
When Varus starts charging Piercing Arrow, sidestep it. He moves slowly while charging, so punish him with Headshot.
Stay away from his Chain of Corruption in fights. If it roots you, you are an easy target; he can reach you from far.
Poke Vayne early with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; she has to walk into your range to trade back.
Place Yordle Snap Trap near walls and behind you before Vayne walks up; if she steps on one, she is rooted and you get a strong headshot.
Stay away from walls when Vayne has Condemn ready. A wall hit stuns you, and she can kill you before you act.
If Vayne dives on you, fire 90 Caliber Net at her. It slows her and pushes you back, giving you space.
Vayne is fragile, so use Ace in the Hole to finish her when she is low. Other enemy champions can block the shot.
Walk around the edge of Event Horizon instead of through it. Only the edge stuns, and being stunned next to Veigar is deadly.
Keep moving when Dark Matter is falling on you. Its warning shows where it lands, so sidestep it.
Poke Veigar with Piltover Peacemaker from long range. He is fragile and has to come close to fight you.
Slow Veigar with the net if he steps up, then back away so he can't follow.
Put Yordle Snap Trap near where you stand so Veigar cannot walk up to you freely.
Do not let Veigar kill minions or hit you with spells. Each champion hit makes him permanently stronger.
Poke Xayah with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; she has to walk into your range to trade back.
Place Yordle Snap Trap behind you and in brush before Xayah can walk up. If she steps on one she is rooted, and you get a bonus Headshot on her.
If Xayah dives onto you, fire the net away from her. You get distance and she is slowed.
Don't fire Ace in the Hole while Xayah's Featherstorm is about to land. She can't be targeted while she is in the air.
Move around when Xayah has fought in one spot for a while. Feathers left on the ground let Bladecaller root you.
Poke Yasuo with Piltover Peacemaker from long range, and line it up so it hits him before it reaches minions.
Place Yordle Snap Trap where Yasuo wants to dash or stand. If he steps on it, he is rooted and takes a bonus Headshot.
Fire your net at Yasuo when he dashes in. He is slowed and you are pushed back out of his reach.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks your shots. Wait until it fades before firing Piltover Peacemaker or Ace in the Hole.
Stay away from his Steel Tempest whirlwind. When he has two stacks, step sideways, or he knocks you up.
Poke Yunara with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; she has no long-range answer, so trade freely while she walks up.
Place Yordle Snap Trap where Yunara stands to last-hit or walks toward you; a rooted Yunara takes a bonus Headshot from long range.
Fire your net away from Yunara if she gets close; you slide back and she is slowed if it hits.
Yunara hits much harder and faster once she uses Transcend One's Self. Keep your distance and your net ready then.
Stay behind minions when Yunara throws her prayer bead; it slows you heavily and you will be easy to catch.
Poke Zeri with Piltover Peacemaker from long range; her Burst Fire reaches much less far, so she cannot answer you.
Place Yordle Snap Trap on the paths Zeri walks, and in the spots she dashes toward. A rooted Zeri takes extra damage from your Headshot.
Zeri's Spark Surge dash crosses walls and gets her away. Keep a trap down and your net ready for when she dashes in or out.
Fire your net when Zeri closes in. It slows her, and the recoil pushes you back so you can keep your range.
Hit Zeri with a net, then follow with an extended-range Headshot while she is still netted.
At level 6, Ace in the Hole can finish Zeri from far away. Her allies can step in front and block the shot.
Outrange Ziggs with Piltover Peacemaker and poke him whenever he steps up to hit a minion. Keep it up in the early levels.
Place Yordle Snap Trap before you need it, in the brush or where Ziggs likes to stand, so one is ready when he comes at you.
Ziggs's mines slow you and set up his other spells. Walk around them, or hit him first when he throws them.
Once Ziggs has used Bouncing Bomb and Satchel Charge, move up and trade. He has few ways to hit back while they recharge.
Ziggs can use Satchel Charge to blast himself away from you. Keep a trap down on his escape path.
Fire your net at Ziggs to slow him if he dives on you. The recoil also moves you out of the way.
